Russian drone strike kills 16 in Ukrainian shopping center

A Russian drone strike on a shopping center in Kryvyi Rih, Ukraine, killed 16 people and wounded over 130. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky vowed a response to the "double-tap" attack, which occurred in his hometown. Russia, meanwhile, warned the UK of "consequences" over its alleged support for Ukraine's use of British-made drones in attacks on Russian economic targets. Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that Ukraine had "opened Pandora's box" by targeting Russian economic sites and would face severe repercussions.
